findings.title: Important Security Update for Plex Media Server v1.43.2 and earlier
findings.summary_md: Plex published a forum announcement urging all Media Server owners and Desktop users to update after releasing Plex Media Server 1.43.3 and Plex Desktop 1.115.0 to address a number of security issues affecting version 1.43.2 and earlier. The company said CVEs had been requested and would be published once assigned, and advised manual installation on NAS devices where package managers lagged. Affected users were also contacted by email.

findings.title: Plex Told Every Server Owner to Patch. It Still Won't Say What It Fixed.
findings.summary_md: BlackTree noted that Plex gave administrators a version target but no CVEs, severity, or attack paths, and pointed to release-note clues in the 1.43.3 line: a potential vulnerability in CompanionProxy and a change preventing network modification of TranscoderH264Options and TranscoderH264OptionsOverride preferences. Plex Desktop 1.115.0, released August 13, was identified as the required Desktop baseline without a disclosed fixed issue. The article advised verifying the installed build and treating internet-exposed servers as priority.
